g.text: AVAILABLE FOR Q2/Q3 ROLES · NEW DELHI / REMOTE
UI/UX Designer · Product Designer · Front-End Engineer
Merging high-craft editorial design systems with production frontend architecture.
Translating intricate human friction points into fluid, responsive, tactile web applications.
Real-time browser retro graphics laboratory for pixel art, dithering, and CRT shaders.
Behavioral financial coaching solving churn via tactile friction sliders and instant feedback.
Enterprise analytics dashboard virtualizing 100,000+ financial rows with sub-16ms frames.
Nostalgic digital journaling transforming memories into tactile receipts and watercolor ink.
Information hierarchy breakdown, friction audits, and structural constraint mapping.
Prototyping responsive layouts with interactive physics, gestures, and tactile feedback.
Building multi-theme Figma token architectures mapped 1-to-1 with Tailwind CSS.
Shipping production-grade React, Next.js, and Canvas code with 98+ Lighthouse scores.
Bridging the Chasm Between Design & Engineering
I am Zaid Saifi, a Product Designer & UI/UX Front-End Engineer specializing in craft-forward web applications.
By speaking both the fluid language of Figma and the strict rigor of TypeScript, I ensure every visual nuance
survives the journey from design artboard into production deployment without quality degradation.
Meticulous craftsmanship in digital interfaces. Merging raw visual weight with reactive frontend logic.
